name: Farkleberry

facts.value: A wild relative of the blueberry

caution: Edible but dry and seedy raw; best cooked. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A tough evergreen blueberry cousin whose small black fruit stays hard and seedy. Not a trailside treat, but a real ingredient once cooked down.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Simmer with sugar and a splash of water to coax out what sweetness there is; the flavor is genuinely blueberry.
